about: P61 T1 sealed quality set: 24 new English sentences written 26. 10. 2026 before the first P61 code change, from the plan's mix only (no lexicon, no run). Families: shooter = shooting or fighting with a distinct setting; collect = collect N things; multi = 2-3 verbs; other = everything else. hero, foe, item, world and count are the sentence's own words, labelled when written. Opened once in T8 (holdout-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: A cowboy shoots skeleton bandits in a dusty desert town
Pirates fight sea monsters on the deck of a sinking ship
A robot blasts space slugs inside a frozen moon base
A ninja battles giant crabs on a tropical beach
A samurai duels shadow warriors in a bamboo forest
A police drone zaps runaway robots in a neon city at night
A squirrel gathers five acorns before winter comes
Find seven lost puppies in a snowy village
A diver collects four pearls from a coral reef while avoiding sharks
Grab ten gold coins in a haunted castle without waking the bats
A little witch picks six glowing mushrooms in a dark swamp
An astronaut recovers three fuel cells scattered across Mars
A kangaroo hops over logs, grabs berries and punches snakes
A skier races down the mountain, dodges pine trees and jumps over cliffs
A firefighter climbs the tower, sprays the flames and rescues a cat
A penguin slides across the ice, catches fish and avoids seals
A farmer plants carrots, waters them and scares away crows
A knight rides through the forest and slays a dragon
Stack pancakes as high as you can in a busy diner
A goldfish escapes from its bowl in a messy kitchen
Guide a paper boat down a rainy street gutter
A bee pollinates flowers in a sunny meadow
Bounce a beach ball on a seal's nose at the circus
Steer a hot air balloon between thunderclouds above the ocean
